title: Can't undefine false pen key sequence

status.label: Retest the Surface pen key-sequence remap on current stable
status.detail: On PowerToys 0.82.1 and a Surface Pro 11, mapping the pen's Win+Ctrl+F20 sequence to Undefined reportedly still triggers Screen Snip and CapsLock; maintainers say this is related to, but distinct from, #23351.

judgment.rationale: The reporter gives a concrete Surface pen sequence: removing the docked pen emits Win(left)+Ctrl(left)+F20, which they map to Undefined, but docking/undocking still toggles CapsLock and launches Screen Snip. The only follow-up rejects an automated duplicate suggestion for #23351. A maintainer later clarified that #33968 shares the false pen-action symptoms with #23351 but is a distinct Keyboard Manager capture/remapping failure and both issues should remain open. The report lists PowerToys 0.82.1, so request a current-build retest without merging it into the related tracker.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.82.1 on WinGet and says the device is a Surface Pro 11.
The pen action emits Win(left)+Ctrl(left)+F20; mapping that sequence to Undefined reportedly does not prevent Screen Snip or CapsLock changes.
The author rejects the automated #23351 duplicate suggestion and says the captured sequence/remap failure is distinct.
A maintainer on #23351 later confirmed #33968 has the same CapsLock/Screen Snip symptoms but a distinct Keyboard Manager capture/remapping failure, and said to keep both issues open.
The last substantive reproduction predates current stable; there are two comments and no assignees.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether mapping Win(left)+Ctrl(left)+F20 to Undefined still fails on v0.102.3001 and whether the same pen dock/undock actions occur.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue has an explicit maintainer distinction from #23351, but its own repro is from PowerToys 0.82.1 and has not been checked on current stable.

issue_context.summary: A Surface pen's Win+Ctrl+F20 sequence reportedly cannot be mapped to Undefined, so docking/undocking still toggles CapsLock and launches Screen Snip.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.82.1 and a Surface Pro 11.
Removing the pen from its dock is captured as Win(left)+Ctrl(left)+F20; mapping this sequence to Undefined reportedly does not suppress the resulting actions.
The reporter says the sequence toggles CapsLock and Screen Snip appears when the pen is returned.
Maintainers explicitly say this capture/remapping failure is related to but distinct from #23351, and both should remain open.
inferences: A current test can determine whether the failure to suppress the captured sequence remains in the current Keyboard Manager implementation; the shared symptoms alone do not make #33968 a duplicate of #23351.
issue_context.analysis: Keep the issue separate from #23351 as the maintainer directed. The specific capture sequence and failed Undefined mapping are useful; only current-build behavior remains to be confirmed.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body and both comments, including the author's response rejecting the automated duplicate suggestion.
Read #23351's latest maintainer comment, which explicitly says #33968 is a distinct capture/remapping failure and both issues should remain open.

information_gaps.information: Whether the captured Win(left)+Ctrl(left)+F20 sequence can still be mapped to Undefined on v0.102.3001 without Screen Snip or CapsLock changes during pen docking/undocking
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is from 0.82.1; a current retest determines whether this is still an active remapping defect while preserving the explicit distinction from #23351.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On v0.102.3001 with the Surface Pro 11 pen, capture the dock/undock sequence and map Win(left)+Ctrl(left)+F20 to Undefined; report whether Screen Snip or CapsLock changes still occur and the Windows build.

actions.label: Retest the Surface pen key-sequence remap

comment.body: Thanks for documenting the Win(left)+Ctrl(left)+F20 sequence and the failed Undefined mapping on your Surface Pro 11. Could you confirm whether the same pen dock/undock behavior still occurs on PowerToys v0.102.3001, including whether Screen Snip opens or CapsLock changes? Please include the current Windows build.
